test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the unit of work done?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Work is said to be done by a force when it moves its point of application through a distance.
 
• Work done = Force × Distance moved
 
• **SI unit of work is joule.** 
 
• **1 J = 1 N.m**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Watt **(W) is the S.I. unit of **power**.
 
• **Ampere **(A) is the S.I. unit of **current**.
 
• **Decibel **is a unit of intensity of **sound**.
